videos.title: What Happens to Your Body After Stopping Ozempic
videos.point: 25-40% of Ozempic weight loss is muscle that does not return when rebound weight comes back as fat, because GLP-1s suppress hunger via the brain and slow digestion.
content: Most weight loss from reduced intake, not metabolic magic
Persistent side effects: gastroparesis, vision loss, hair loss, pancreatitis
Rebuild with resistance training plus leucine-rich animal protein
videos.watch_why: Gives concrete muscle-loss percentage and actionable recovery steps beyond the title claim.

videos.title: Cast Iron Leaving Black Residue? It's Not Your Seasoning
videos.point: Black residue on cast iron is carbonized food buildup from high heat, not a failed seasoning layer, and is removed by soap plus a stiff brush.
content: High-heat cooks (lasagna example) leave carbon that wipes onto towels
Lower heat prevents new carbon formation
Soap does not strip seasoning; dry and store without oil if preferred
videos.watch_why: Debunks the common seasoning myth with a specific cleaning mechanism and steps.

videos.title: IPCON PPA-CF vs PPA-GF: One Is the Strongest Filament I've Ever Tested
videos.point: IPCON PPA-CF shows higher flexural strength (~256 MPa XY) and near-zero deformation under load compared with PPA-GF in three-point bending and torsion tests.
content: PPA-CF flexural strength 256 MPa vs GF 155 MPa (XY); heat deflection 227°C both
CF version had zero residual deformation after load removal in bending tests
Print slower than rated 250 mm/s for best layer adhesion and strength
videos.watch_why: Side-by-side mechanical test data with numbers; relevant for high-temp structural prints.
